name: Greek Turkey Spinach & Feta Meatball Bake

fit.note: 404 cal (>=400), 13 g carb (<=35), no seafood, batch-form meatballs in a 9x13 and multiply x3.5 for 14 servings; clears all conditions.

dupe_evidence: Not a duplicate of any live-catalog turkey meatball dish. Closest neighbor greek-turkey-meatballs-with-lemon-orzo shares the Greek+feta+turkey-meatball flavor family but is a meatball-over-pasta plate (orzo starch base, higher carb) whereas this is a starchless baked meatball dish; greek-turkey-spanakorizo-skillet shares turkey+feta+spinach but is a rice skillet, not meatballs; greek-turkey-youvarlakia is an egg-lemon meatball-and-rice braise. Three distinct plates, none is this starchless spinach-in-the-meatball bake.
cross_protein_collision_flags: Structurally this is 'spinach + feta meatballs, starchless bake' in Greek/Mediterranean flavor. A beef, pork, or chicken Greek/Mediterranean spinach-feta meatball (e.g. a chicken 'Greek meatball bake' or beef keftedes-style spinach-feta meatball) in another selector's pool would be the same dish in a different protein - decider should check for a same-dish-different-protein twin.

Milder overlap with any 'Mediterranean feta meatball' candidate regardless of starch; the low-carb starchless format is the distinguishing hook, so a version served over orzo/rice/potato is a different plate and should not be merged against this one.
